Definition
[Strainers] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0427 ↗ def:chow-iii-g35-g36-aleksandrov 1. appG:G.41\group Aleksandrov structure

A point is $(m,\epsilon )$-strained if it admits pairs $(a_i,b_i)$ whose comparison angles satisfy $\widetilde\angle a_ipb_i>\pi -\epsilon $ and all cross-angles exceed $\pi /2-10\epsilon $. The pairs form an $(m,\epsilon )$-strainer.
